caption: The drawing shows a detailed, monochrome illustration of a piece of lace or crocheted edge, rendered in shades of gray and white. The lace section is rectangular at the top, with three downward-pointing triangular sections along the bottom edge. The top edge is straight and finished with a tightly woven band, while the area just below has a horizontal band of small, square or rectangular openwork patterns. The central portion of the lace features an intricate openwork design composed of circular and oval holes bordered by fine thread, creating a repeating pattern. The lower portion of the lace is denser and more tightly woven, forming the triangular points at the bottom. The background is plain, with a light, slightly yellowed tone, and the lace is centered within a square frame lightly drawn on the paper. Below the illustration, the words "Section - Full Size" and the name "Frank J. Mace" are inscribed in small letters.
title: Knitted Lace Edging
